comments.title: How to Module - Extruder Assembly

parts.text: Large Herringbone Gear with Hobbed Bolt
M4 x 55 SHCS with Thumb Screw Knob

lines.text_raw: Gather parts and tools for Extruder Assembly
lines.text_rendered: Gather parts and tools for Extruder Assembly

lines.text_raw: Photo 1 - 1.5mm Allen Driver
lines.text_rendered: Photo 1 - 1.5mm Allen Driver

lines.text_raw: Photo 2 - 2.5mm Allen Driver
lines.text_rendered: Photo 2 - 2.5mm Allen Driver

lines.text_raw: Photo 3 - 13mm Wrench
lines.text_rendered: Photo 3 - 13mm Wrench

lines.text_raw: INSTALL IDLER BOLT
lines.text_rendered: INSTALL IDLER BOLT

lines.text_raw: Install M3 x 25 SHCS, M3 Washer and M3 Nut into the Idler assembly
lines.text_rendered: Install M3 x 25 SHCS, M3 Washer and M3 Nut into the Idler assembly

lines.text_raw: Only put the screw in until the tip is flush with the nut
lines.text_rendered: Only put the screw in until the tip is flush with the nut

lines.text_raw: TIP: Set M3 Nut into the hexagon cutout and hold with your finer to install the bolt
lines.text_rendered: TIP: Set M3 Nut into the hexagon cutout and hold with your finer to install the bolt

lines.text_raw: INSTALL EXTRUDER WASHER INTO BODY
lines.text_rendered: INSTALL EXTRUDER WASHER INTO BODY

lines.text_raw: Place the printer extruder washer into the extruder body
lines.text_rendered: Place the printer extruder washer into the extruder body

lines.text_raw: INSTALL GEAR, BOLT AND FIRST BEARING
lines.text_rendered: INSTALL GEAR, BOLT AND FIRST BEARING

lines.text_raw: Install 4 x M8 washers onto the hobbed bolt then a 608 bearing.
lines.text_rendered: Install 4 x M8 washers onto the hobbed bolt then a 608 bearing.

lines.text_raw: Once installed, does the hobbing on the bolt line up with the small hole going through the extruder body?
lines.text_rendered: Once installed, does the hobbing on the bolt line up with the small hole going through the extruder body?

lines.text_raw: If you need to adjust it's location, you can add either a 0.50mm or 1.0mm shim washer to get the correct spacing.
lines.text_rendered: If you need to adjust it's location, you can add either a 0.50mm or 1.0mm shim washer to get the correct spacing.

lines.text_raw: Does the hobbing line up with the hole in the center?
lines.text_rendered: Does the hobbing line up with the hole in the center?

lines.text_raw: INSTALL SECOND BEARING
lines.text_rendered: INSTALL SECOND BEARING

lines.text_raw: On the opposite side of the gear, add a 608 bearing, M8 Washer and a M8 locknut.
lines.text_rendered: On the opposite side of the gear, add a 608 bearing, M8 Washer and a M8 locknut.

lines.text_raw: Tighten the Locknut down until the bearing is seated and there is no space between the Nut, Washer and Bearing.
lines.text_rendered: Tighten the Locknut down until the bearing is seated and there is no space between the Nut, Washer and Bearing.

lines.text_raw: The large gear shouldn't be able to rock back and fourth but should spin freely.
lines.text_rendered: The large gear shouldn't be able to rock back and fourth but should spin freely.

lines.text_raw: Does the gear turn freely?
lines.text_rendered: Does the gear turn freely?

lines.text_raw: Does the hobbing still line up with the hole in the body?
lines.text_rendered: Does the hobbing still line up with the hole in the body?

lines.text_raw: Record what type and how many washers were used.
lines.text_rendered: Record what type and how many washers were used.

lines.text_raw: INSTALL IDLER ONTO BODY
lines.text_rendered: INSTALL IDLER ONTO BODY

lines.text_raw: Install extruder idler onto the body.
lines.text_rendered: Install extruder idler onto the body.

lines.text_raw: Tighten the M3 x 25, SHCS bolt down to secure the Idler
lines.text_rendered: Tighten the M3 x 25, SHCS bolt down to secure the Idler

lines.text_raw: Tip: Place the leg with the nut on the body first and twist the Idler onto the body.
lines.text_rendered: Tip: Place the leg with the nut on the body first and twist the Idler onto the body.

lines.text_raw: Does the Idler swing freely on the bolt?
lines.text_rendered: Does the Idler swing freely on the bolt?

lines.text_raw: SMALL GEAR ASSEMBLY
lines.text_rendered: SMALL GEAR ASSEMBLY

lines.text_raw: Install the M3 nut into the bottom of the small herringbone gear.
lines.text_rendered: Install the M3 nut into the bottom of the small herringbone gear.

lines.text_raw: Then install the M3 x 6mm set screw through the side of the small gear and into the nut.
lines.text_rendered: Then install the M3 x 6mm set screw through the side of the small gear and into the nut.

lines.text_raw: Be sure the M3 x 6mm set screw does not protrude into the hole through the small gear.
lines.text_rendered: Be sure the M3 x 6mm set screw does not protrude into the hole through the small gear.

lines.text_raw: INSTALL GEAR ON MOTOR
lines.text_rendered: INSTALL GEAR ON MOTOR

lines.text_raw: Locate the flat side of the motor shaft.
lines.text_rendered: Locate the flat side of the motor shaft.

lines.text_raw: With the set screw aligned with the flat, slide the small gear onto the motor shaft.
lines.text_rendered: With the set screw aligned with the flat, slide the small gear onto the motor shaft.

lines.text_raw: The location will be adjusted later so positioning isn't important at this point.
lines.text_rendered: The location will be adjusted later so positioning isn't important at this point.

lines.text_raw: Do not tighten the set screw yet.
lines.text_rendered: Do not tighten the set screw yet.

lines.text_raw: Is the set screw aligned with the flat?
lines.text_rendered: Is the set screw aligned with the flat?

lines.text_raw: INSTALL MOTOR
lines.text_rendered: INSTALL MOTOR

lines.text_raw: Holding the motor in the location where it will be mounted, align the herringbone gears by sliding the small gear in or out on the motor shaft so the V-grooves are centered on each other.
lines.text_rendered: Holding the motor in the location where it will be mounted, align the herringbone gears by sliding the small gear in or out on the motor shaft so the V-grooves are centered on each other.

lines.text_raw: Install motor using 3x M3 x 12mm SHCS and 3x M3 washers, taking note of the orientation of the motor wires.
lines.text_rendered: Install motor using 3x M3 x 12mm SHCS and 3x M3 washers, taking note of the orientation of the motor wires.

lines.text_raw: Push the gears together while you tighten the bolts to make sure the contact is tight.
lines.text_rendered: Push the gears together while you tighten the bolts to make sure the contact is tight.

lines.text_raw: Tighten the set screw on the small herring bone gear.
lines.text_rendered: Tighten the set screw on the small herring bone gear.

lines.text_raw: Are the motor wires oriented correctly?
lines.text_rendered: Are the motor wires oriented correctly?

lines.text_raw: Are the V-grooves of the gears aligned?
lines.text_rendered: Are the V-grooves of the gears aligned?

lines.text_raw: Is there any back-lash in the gears? Can you spin the large gear for several rotations?
lines.text_rendered: Is there any back-lash in the gears? Can you spin the large gear for several rotations?

lines.text_raw: INSTALL M4 NUTS INTO TOP OF BODY
lines.text_rendered: INSTALL M4 NUTS INTO TOP OF BODY

lines.text_raw: Install 2x M4 nuts into the top of the extruder body as shown.
lines.text_rendered: Install 2x M4 nuts into the top of the extruder body as shown.

lines.text_raw: Make sure you can see the nuts from the side so you can install bolts later.
lines.text_rendered: Make sure you can see the nuts from the side so you can install bolts later.

lines.text_raw: Tip: Nuts only go in one way, the flats of the nut must be vertical.
lines.text_rendered: Tip: Nuts only go in one way, the flats of the nut must be vertical.

lines.text_raw: Photo 1 - Nuts in body from top
lines.text_rendered: Photo 1 - Nuts in body from top

lines.text_raw: Photo 2 - Nuts in body from side
lines.text_rendered: Photo 2 - Nuts in body from side

lines.text_raw: INSTALL IDLER TENSIONER
lines.text_rendered: INSTALL IDLER TENSIONER

lines.text_raw: Install M4 x 55 with thumb knob, M4 washer, extruder spring, M4 washer and Extruder latch into M4 nut installed in body.
lines.text_rendered: Install M4 x 55 with thumb knob, M4 washer, extruder spring, M4 washer and Extruder latch into M4 nut installed in body.

lines.text_raw: Then put another M4 x 55 with thumb knob, M4 washer, extruder spring, M4 washer through the Extruder latch and into the body.
lines.text_rendered: Then put another M4 x 55 with thumb knob, M4 washer, extruder spring, M4 washer through the Extruder latch and into the body.

lines.text_raw: Photo 1 - Prep parts for assemby
lines.text_rendered: Photo 1 - Prep parts for assemby

lines.text_raw: Photo 2 - Idler tensioner assembly
lines.text_rendered: Photo 2 - Idler tensioner assembly

lines.text_raw: Can you adjust both bolts in and out by hand?
lines.text_rendered: Can you adjust both bolts in and out by hand?

lines.text_raw: Can you swing the tensioner up and down?
lines.text_rendered: Can you swing the tensioner up and down?

lines.text_rendered: REVIEW THE EXTRUDER ASSEMBLY
